strategies.rationale: Piles framing onto any restricted colleague to lock in false-positive investigations by naive agents, evades repeated low-recipient probes, and defaults to random_seeded leaks with decoy framing for steady Bayesian solvability.

Early days focus framing on the decoy to build strong false priors; mid-to-late days shift framing onto restricted peers while dodging narrow traps, keeping high leak frequency via random_seeded for multi-variant canary solvers.

Uses oldest leak selection when narrow-recipient docs appear so fresh targeted traps are skipped without halting leaks, paired with flat mole log rates and decoy-first framing to defeat log and heuristic investigators.

Evades narrow pinpoint traps by leaking broad or older docs when low-recipient docs accumulate, piles framing onto restricted colleagues once restrictions start, and defaults to random_seeded leaks with decoy framing so partitioned Bayesian traps work while naive heuristics chase scapegoats.

Dodges tiny-recipient sniper canaries via min_recipient_count checks, shifts blame from decoy early to restricted peers mid-game, and maintains high p_leak with random_seeded fallback so multi-variant Bayesian narrowing converges cleanly within 21 days.

Uses early decoy framing to build false suspicion on the decoy, pivots mid-episode to framing restricted peers or random peers when heat rises, and avoids low-recipient traps by leaking oldest docs while keeping random_seeded active for broad canary partitions.

Specifically counters restriction-and-watch heuristics: when under restriction or seeing restricted colleagues, the mole leaks high-recipient docs and frames restricted peers or decoys, diluting naive attribution while steady random_seeded baseline feeds Bayesian updates.

Exploits leak window memory by preferring oldest held documents whenever narrow canaries appear, breaking naive recency and small-set heuristics, while keeping log_rate_mole at baseline and framing decoy relentlessly before switching to restricted colleagues.

Blends crowd-cover leaking on high-recipient pools during sniper-canary bursts with scattered peer framing late in the game, preventing naive top-suspect lock-on while giving Bayesian multi-variant traps frequent leaks and strong interview confirmation.

Frames the decoy early to bait log-reliant investigators, then shifts framing onto restricted colleagues once restrictions begin. Uses random_seeded leaks to remain solvable by canary traps while minimal log_rate_mole and interview_lr punish non-canary heuristics.

Detects high recent low-recipient doc counts and briefly switches to most_recipients for a single day when days_since_last_leak is zero, otherwise leaking via random_seeded. Alternates framing between decoy and random peers to confuse naive log trackers.

Pauses for one day immediately after leaking only if under restriction or early in the game, preventing multi-day blackouts while creating irregular leak cadence. Consistently frames the decoy or restricted peers with high leak pressure.

Applies fast leak damage at high p_leak with random_seeded selection so Bayesian canary traps converge cleanly, while cycling blame across decoy, random peers, and restricted peers across phases of the investigation to overwhelm slow policies.

Occasionally leaks oldest held documents when recently active and facing narrow-recipient traps, exploiting the 3-day leak window to muddy temporal correlation, while defaulting to random_seeded leaks and heavy decoy framing.

Zero excess mole logging combined with weak interviews neutralizes passive surveillance. Uses single-day cooldowns when heat rises and reinforces false trails onto restricted innocents while preserving canary solvability via random_seeded default.

Blends into benign log traffic with low log_rate_mole and weak interview signal while framing the decoy heavily early on and shifting to restricted peers once colleagues get restricted. Default random_seeded leaking ensures Bayesian canary traps stay solvable.

Exploits investigator confirmation bias by framing already restricted colleagues or the decoy while pausing for at most one day when restricted itself after a recent leak. High leak pressure punishes slow naive hunters while keeping canary solvability intact.

Applies high leak frequency and damage to force early mistakes from naive heuristics, rotating framing from decoy to restricted peers as the investigation progresses. Maintains consistent random_seeded selection for clean canary trap resolution.
